description: Sanitize untrusted HTML (LLM output, user comments, scraped pages, email bodies) with a strict allowlist before rendering it: three profiles (strict inline formatting, basic with links and lists, rich with images and tables) or a custom tag list; drops scripts, styles, iframes, forms, SVG/MathML, event handlers, javascript:/vbscript:/data: URLs and comments; adds rel="noopener noreferrer nofollow" (+ optional target=_blank) to links; returns clean HTML, a plain-text version and a report of everything removed. Price: $0.002 USDC per successful call (x402, Solana). Same tool over HTTPS: POST https://scorptech.it.com/api/x402/v1/html-sanitize
